Desirable: Doctoral Degree in Fashion/Design/Craft Junior Faculty - Pattern Making & Garment Construction: Master's Degree (min. 02 years after Graduation) in Fashion Design/Apparel Design/Garment Manufacturing Technology/Fashion Technology/Textile & Clothing/Apparel Manufacturing/Knitwear Design/Leather Design/Textile Design or Equivalent with min. 55% marks from a recognized university/Institute. Desirable: Doctoral Degree in Fashion Design/Fashion Technology/Relevant Field Lab Assistant - Pattern Making & Garment Construction: Essential: 8th Pass. Desirable: 10th Pass. Must be responsible for documentation, record keeping and upkeep of the department. Should be able to operate/sew garments and repair sewing machines like lock stitch, overlock and flatlock

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the FDDI Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of FDDI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Footwear Design & Development Institute (FDDI), a premier institution in design and development. It is a government job opportunity.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names available in this FDDI recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Junior Faculty and Academic Support Staff, including specific roles like Junior Faculty for Illustration & CAD, Design Process, Pattern Making & Garment Construction, and Lab Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced in FDDI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Junior Faculty and Academic Support Staff positions across various departments at FDDI.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for FDDI Junior Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the FDDI Junior Faculty and Academic Support Staff posts is entirely online. Candidates need to submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for FDDI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for interested and eligible candidates to submit their online applications for the FDDI recruitment is 13 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Junior Faculty posts at FDDI?
faq.answer: For Junior Faculty posts, candidates generally need a Master's Degree (minimum 02 years after Graduation) in relevant design or fashion fields with at least 55% marks. A Doctoral Degree is desirable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification for the Lab Assistant post at FDDI?
faq.answer: For the Lab Assistant position, the essential qualification is 8th Pass, with 10th Pass being desirable. Practical skills in machine operation and garment construction are also required.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Junior Faculty positions at FDDI?
faq.answer: The salary for Junior Faculty positions, including Illustration & CAD, Design Process, and Pattern Making & Garment Construction, is Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for the Lab Assistant post at FDDI?
faq.answer: The salary for the Lab Assistant - Pattern Making & Garment Construction post at Footwear Design & Development Institute (FDDI) is Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for FDDI Junior Faculty and Academic Support Staff?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Faculty and Academic Support Staff positions at FDDI primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and called for an interview.
